notes: Test prompts for the AutoSocial orchestrator skill. Publishing evals cannot be run end-to-end without a real logged-in session and would post publicly; treat those as manual/dry checks. Read-only and queue-preparation prompts are safe to run against a running dashboard.

evals.prompt: Quiero empezar a publicar Reels y Shorts automáticamente con AutoSocial. Ponme en marcha: ¿qué me falta para poder publicar en Instagram y YouTube?
evals.expected_output: Ensures deps/dashboard, runs the health check, and reports exactly what's missing (e.g. .env, no saved sessions), then walks the human through logging in. Does not attempt to enter credentials.

evals.prompt: Encola este vídeo para Instagram y YouTube con el texto 'Lanzamiento de mi app 🚀 #buildinpublic' y publícalo ya en Instagram.
evals.expected_output: Queues the clip (+ caption sidecar) into the instagram and youtube pending folders, confirms the exact caption/account/platform, asks for explicit approval before the Instagram run-once, then reports lastResult honestly.

evals.prompt: Programa que se publique en YouTube todos los días a las 9:00 y las 18:30 hora de Madrid.
evals.expected_output: Sets TZ appropriately, uses schedule:daily for youtube with 09:00,18:30, confirms the recurring cadence is authorized, and starts the scheduler; notes schedulers don't survive a dashboard restart.

evals.prompt: Se supone que programé un post pero no ha salido nada. ¿Qué ha pasado?
evals.expected_output: Reads status <platform> (running flag, schedulePlan, logs, lastResult), checks the restart-clears-schedulers and TZ/jitter gotchas, and checks whether the session is still valid — diagnoses from data rather than guessing.

evals.prompt: Añade una marca nueva llamada 'Mi Segundo Canal' y déjala activa para trabajar con ella.
evals.expected_output: Calls account:add "Mi Segundo Canal", confirms it became active, and explains that queues/sessions are now isolated per that brand.
